command: From qwen_claude_field_theory/closure_2026/fried_chicken_2026 run separately: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 test_dw_q0_branch_dirac_2026.py ; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 dw_q0_branch_dirac_2026.py

mathematics.assertion_tested: Restart the localized DW auxiliary Legendre analysis directly on Q=0, separately at lambda!=0 and lambda=0; derive exact Hessian null vectors, branch Legendre/Hamilton-Pontryagin energies, preservation equations and Poisson matrices; and determine whether the fixed-background finite-k (X,xi) block disappears on either stratum.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact SymPy expressions over rational functions of N, a0, c and canonical variables. The arbitrary smooth f is represented by its symbolic two-jet f0+f1*Z+f2*Z^2/2, which is sufficient for the Hessian and linearized principal symbol. No numerical rank tolerance is used.
mathematics.conventions: Metric signature (-,+,+,+); c=a0^2/kappa; homogeneous Z=-4*Xdot^2/(N^2*a0^2); Fourier Delta maps to -k^2; canonical PB is sum_q (dF/dq*dG/dp-dF/dp*dG/dq). Differentiation precedes every Q=0 substitution.

bounds.hessian_and_preservation: Homogeneous fixed-lapse, frozen-metric auxiliary sector. Both Q=0/lambda!=0 and Q=lambda=0 strata are evaluated exactly.
bounds.spatial_tangency: Linear Fourier mode around grad(Xbar)=0 and p_xi_bar=v!=0; k=0 and k!=0 are explicit.
bounds.pole_audit: Quadratic fixed-background (X,xi) sector around constant X with W=c; arbitrary positive f'(0), with no metric perturbations retained.

non_claims: The intrinsic branch Poisson nullity is not interpreted as a gauge or physical DOF count for the irregular embedded branch.
No full spatial distributional Poisson matrix is calculated.
No lapse, shift, spatial metric, or curvature-response ADM momentum is included.
No full ADM N_grav count, PPN result, FLRW perturbation result, or canonical retarded-history construction is claimed.
The computation is not a no-go theorem for every possible causal nonlocal variational formalism.

checks: Exact maximal minors give Hessian ranks 3 and 2 on the two Q=0 lambda strata.
Every supplied Hessian null vector is multiplied into the independently derived undivided Hessian and gives zero.
Restricting Q=0 before differentiating is retained as a mutation that changes the null direction.
Both branch energies have zero residual against a direct p.v-L derivation.
Poisson matrices are generated from the displayed branch relations and canonical bracket, with exact maximal-minor witnesses.
Transverse lambda and M equations fix clock/transport velocities and expose the irregular multiplier tie.
The quadratic (X,xi) density is obtained as an epsilon-series coefficient of QW-cM at W=c.
The kinetic determinant is -1, the exact inertia is one positive plus one negative direction, and finite-k versus k=0 poles are separate.
Linear spatial Q tangency has unit coefficient on u_M, so it fixes that multiplier rather than generating a new constraint.
result: The Q=0 rank drop does not remove the indefinite (X,xi) scalar block: the unrestricted independent-auxiliary local representative is DEAD. The homogeneous embedded branch closes on both lambda strata but is irregular, so its intrinsic Poisson nullity is not promoted to a Dirac gauge count. Full spatial+ADM and retarded-history formulations remain open.
residual_risks: The DEAD classification is established in the fixed-background/decoupling scalar sector; the full metric-coupled constraint algebra has not been recomputed here.
The finite-k pole calculation uses a constant-X background and f'(0); nonconstant backgrounds can add mixing but cannot be inferred from this bounded run.
Spatial Q tangency is linearized about one homogeneous background family.
A causal retarded prescription may select a noncanonical solution subset and requires a separate variational construction.
